subject: Depression (Remnant of Severe Cyclonic Storm “Akvan”) weakened into a Well Marked Low Pressure Area over Central Odisha.
name: Akvan
paragraphs: The Depression (Remnant of Severe Cyclonic Storm “Akvan”) over south coastal Odisha moved northwards and weakened into a Well Marked Low Pressure Area over Central Odisha and at 2330 hours IST of yesterday, the 20th November, 2026. It is likely to move nearly northwards over Odisha and weaken further into a Low Pressure Area during next 06 hours.
